items.title: Invention 13
items.synopsis: On a cold, windy night, a frustrated pianist encounters strange obstacles while trying to learn  Bach's notoriously intricate Invention 13.

items.title: Obscure Identity
items.synopsis: In an era of sensory overload and conspiracy, the line between truth and delusion is razor thin. When a woman is stuck in the liminal space of an airport baggage claim, she must know the difference before paranoia (or worse) consumes her.

items.title: SONG OF MY MOTHER'S SOUL
items.synopsis: IDina, a sound recordist, and her mother, a classical singer, share a bond shaped by unspoken emotions and widening distance. As her mother’s health fades, Dina turns to sound to preserve her presence and memory.

items.title: People's Lives
items.synopsis: With its story full of love, ambition, and intrigue, the series, which is set to break the mold in the new season, focuses on the dangerous test faced by a young woman who envies the lives of others.

items.title: Bad Look
items.synopsis: After her first nude photo shoot, an ambitious model becomes unsettled by the way a well-known photographer has framed and interpreted her body. When she confronts him to regain control of the images, their negotiation spirals into a charged argument that exposes the power and insecurity underlying their collaboration.

items.title: Ömür Usta
items.synopsis: "Ömür Usta," built around family ties, betrayal, love, class conflicts, and second chances, will tell the story of a woman who, despite all her wounds, manages to hold on to life and rediscover her own light.

items.title: Still Flipping Out
items.synopsis: Former “Flipping Out” star Jeff Lewis navigates the demands of his hit SiriusXM show on Radio Andy, an eponymous design empire, and everything in-between.

items.title: Shayad Yahi Hai Pyaar
items.synopsis: Escaping a toxic relationship, 35-year-old Preeti finds love and solace with Aarav. But the age gap stigma follows them everywhere! Can love overpower it all?

items.title: Mission: Mompossible
items.synopsis: Two families collide when their children fall in love. One mother sacrifices everything before she dies to secure her children's future, while the other ruthlessly abandons her daughter for greed. Caught between ultimate sacrifice and ultimate betrayal, the two leads must survive the destructive secrets of their rival households.

items.title: LEGO ONE PIECE
items.synopsis: Usopp spins a tall tale about the Straw Hats' journey across the East Blue into the Grand Line before Chopper joined the crew.

items.title: Digger
items.synopsis: The most powerful man in the world embarks on a frantic mission to prove he is humanity's savior before the disaster he's unleashed destroys everything.

items.title: Verity
items.synopsis: Lowen Ashleigh is hired by Jeremy Crawford to ghostwrite novels for his bestselling author wife Verity, who is unable to finish following an accident. Lowen gradually uncovers Verity's disturbing truths while residing at the Crawfords' home to work.

items.title: LINKIN PARK: UNSHATTER
items.synopsis: After a seven-year hiatus following the devastating loss of their beloved bandmate Chester Bennington, LINKIN PARK'S remaining members struggled to find their way forward. Their shared history and enduring friendship, combined with the fresh perspective of two new band members Emily Armstrong and Colin Brittain spark a renewed creative energy that leads them on a transformative journey of artistic reinvention. Following the band from intimate 2022 studio sessions through their explosive FROM ZERO album release and concert in São Paulo, this documentary weaves together rare vault footage, electrifying performances from sold-out shows, and candid interviews with band members and fans—capturing the raw, honest story of what it means to start over.

items.title: V/H/S/Mixtape
items.synopsis: V/H/S/MIXTAPE cranks the volume on horror with a blood-soaked collection of cursed music videos, terrifying performances, and found footage. Press play. Pray it stops.

items.title: Rizzler News
items.synopsis: A show about the rise of Rob the newsman as he builds Rizzler News from the ground and single handedly destroys the competition

items.title: Unmasking a Monster: Aileen Wuornos
items.synopsis: A three-part docuseries examining the life and crimes of notorious American serial killer Aileen Wuornos, who shot and killed seven male clients while working as a prostitute in Florida in 1989 and 1990. She was arrested in 1991 and spent around 10 years on death row before being executed in 2002.

items.title: Voice of Bangladesh
items.synopsis: Voice of Bangladesh is the official music selection show where artists compete for a historic chance to become their country's very first representative at the debut Eurovision Song Contest Asia. This television project will culminate in a grand final, where the jury and viewers will choose the winner who will win the right to defend their country's honor on the international stage.

items.title: Death Whisperer: Saming the Werebeast
items.original_title: ธี่หยด: สมิงเขาขวาง
items.synopsis: Follows the search for a missing military officer in the jungle of Khao Khwang, where legend says man-eating tiger spirit Saming takes human form in 1960s Thailand.

items.title: Rule 101
items.synopsis: A wealthy professor consumed by sex addiction. A group of students drawn into a forbidden ethical abyss. When a dangerous game of temptation and taboo takes an unexpected turn — a student mysteriously disappears, and everyone believes their secrets will be buried forever. But the arrival of a new face becomes the first domino to fall. The carefully constructed lies, hidden desires, and painful truths of the past begin to unravel, exposing a world of deception and obsession one layer at a time.

items.title: Beware Boiúna
items.synopsis: Deep in the Amazon, a medical mission spirals into a fight for survival when Boiúna, a colossal ancient predator, awakens to reclaim her domain. In the jungle where nature holds absolute power, she decides who lives and who dies.

items.title: Dust
items.synopsis: Sam's curiosity about life and death deepens on a family backpacking trip, where we see nature, loss, and the cycle of existence through the lens of a six-year-old child.

items.title: Coven Academy
items.synopsis: In the haunted heart of New Orleans, follow three teenage witches and their dangerously charming warlock peers at an elite magic boarding school where power is currency, secrets are lethal and attraction is a liability. Caught between ancient supernatural wars and forbidden love interests, the coven must decide how far they’re willing to go to protect their city—and themselves.

items.title: War
items.synopsis: An anthology series set in the elite world of London law following two rival firms, Cathcarts and Taylor & Byrne, as they face off in a different headline-making legal battle each season.

items.title: East of Eden
items.synopsis: In the early 1900s, a fiercely independent woman drives a rift between two brothers, igniting a saga that unfolds across two generations.

items.title: Archive X: Unexplained Phenomena
items.synopsis: Hosted by Professor Jeffrey J. Kripal, one of the leading scholars of extraordinary human experiences, this docuseries builds upon Rice University's Center for the Impossible, one of the world's largest collections of paranormal research, by inviting everyday individuals, many of whom have never spoken publicly before, to reveal their new and personal encounters with unexplained phenomena.

items.title: Fake Doctors, Real Friends with Zach and Donald
items.original_title: Fake Doctors, Real Friends with Zach and Donald
items.synopsis: Scrubs stars and longtime friends Zach Braff and Donald Faison revisit the beloved hospital comedy episode by episode, sharing behind-the-scenes stories, memories from the set and conversations with cast members and fans.

items.title: Renegade Immortal: Battle of the Immortal Slayer
Break Clause
items.synopsis: Their relationship's over. Their tenancy isn't. Break Clause follows Ben and Lil as they navigate their breakup whilst stuck in the same flat. Moving on from your first love is hard enough. Moving out is even harder...

items.title: Rolling Loud: The Movie
items.synopsis: A father makes a bad parenting choice by taking his young son to a wild hip-hop festival, leading to chaos as they navigate crowds, security, and family dynamics with eccentric companions.

items.title: The Last First: Winter K2
items.synopsis: A historic race to become the first to summit K2 in winter unravels into tragedy, exposing how ambition, ego, and the pursuit of glory can be as dangerous as the mountain itself.

items.title: Africa Earth's Wild Home
items.synopsis: African wildlife and landscapes is brought to the screen like never before, using the latest technology to tell the most extraordinary stories from the continent and cutting-edge CGI to unearth the deep history and forces that shaped Africa's natural worlds.

items.title: Love After Lockup: Relationship Rehab
items.synopsis: Five fan-favorite couples from the hit Love After Lockup franchise will join psychiatrist and nationally recognized relationship expert, Dr. Ish Major, to repair their broken bonds.

items.title: Drishyam: The Conclusion
items.synopsis: Years after outsmarting the police, Vijay Salgaonkar's past resurfaces when a new evidence threatens to expose his secret. As the investigation reopens, he must outwit the system once again to save his family.

items.title: Prem Keetanu
items.synopsis: A group of young men and their turbulent college life, where bad grades and hopelessness remain in the driver's seat. Even as they pursue love, friendship and aspirations, the film promises to capture the current generation's struggles and dreams in a light-hearted yet heartfelt manner.

items.title: Pooja Meri Jaan
items.synopsis: After Pooja rejects Aniket’s romantic advances, his subsequent death by suicide leaves her facing accusations. As lawyer and friend Sana investigates the circumstances surrounding the incident, questions of obsession, consent, responsibility and the truth behind Pooja’s relationship with Aniket begin to emerge.

items.title: Teen Kauwe
items.synopsis: An Out and Out Comedy

items.title: Blood Money
items.synopsis: In the Albanian port city of Durrës, Arion, a former inmate, is released from prison to fight in illegal bare-knuckle bouts at the notorious venue «The Circle» on behalf of Ilir, who is heavily in debt. Club owner Hans is initially skeptical of Arion. However, as Arion attracts more and more attention, Hans recognizes his commercial potential as well. What begins as a way out of poverty turns into a risky game when Ilir becomes involved in an illegal betting ring.

items.title: Kill Jackie
items.synopsis: Jackie Price has been living a wealthy, luxurious life for the past 20 years after escaping a dangerous past as an international cocaine dealer. But just as life begins to feel a little boring, she discovers that The Seven Demons, a group of the world’s most terrifying hitmen, have been hired to kill her.

items.title: Hunger
items.synopsis: A modern soap opera about a family that has always put work first—until everything threatens to collapse. When their father, Tommy, can no longer run the restaurant, his children Agnes and Oscar are forced to take responsibility for both the finances and the emotional fallout. The small town’s gaze is unforgiving, and the restaurant becomes a stage where betrayal, love, shame, and pride play out before guests and neighbors alike. Amidst the chaos, they strive to save the restaurant, their relationships, and themselves.

items.title: A Statement
items.synopsis: At a beachside resort in Florida in 1980, twenty experts gather for a weekend conference on a global issue that is starting to gain traction: the effects of Co2 emissions on the climate. The group of scientists, activists, and policymakers have one simple mandate from Congress — write a statement about what to do. Easier said than done.

items.title: #I'm Looking for Zombie
items.synopsis: It may be a ruined city ravaged by zombies, but to Aki and her friends, it's amazing! Having grown up only hearing stories of the old world and the mysterious outbreak that wiped out humanity, she sets off with her childhood friends in search of her missing father. Things quickly become a fight for survival outside the safety of their small village, yet they've never felt more alive.

items.title: Get Jiro
items.synopsis: In a post-apocalyptic, near-future Los Angeles where culinary culture reigns supreme, the world's most powerful figures are chefs, and food is both currency and a demarcation of class, the mysterious sushi chef Jiro sets out on a quest for vengeance.

items.title: Even the Student Council Has Its Holes!
items.synopsis: In a student council filled with weirdos, one new member is about to have a hell of a school year! Mizunoe Ume just wanted to avoid repeating a grade when he joined the student council. After all, it seemed like an easy fix to his current academic problems. But then, he met his fellow council members. Each of them is eccentric in their own way—one's an airhead, another's scary, one's secretly a pervert, but all in all, they're just really weird! Yet somehow, they're also oddly cute and endearing. Which means Mizunoe is stuck with them and all the chaos they bring to the table. Get ready for a slice-of-life story that's irresistibly charming, quirky, and a little bit naughty!

items.title: Super Why's Comic Book Adventures
items.synopsis: Follow the adventures of Power Paige, the newest member of the Super Readers, who joins Super Why, Wonder Red, Princess Presto, and Alpha Pig, as they protect the comic book world of Reader Valley, a universe where letters, words, and sounds have enormous power, from a group of literacy villains and other strange anomalies with the help of the home viewer - Super YOU! Set in a visually fantastic 2D comic book world, these heroic adventures expand preschool and kindergarten literacy skills through high-stakes, action-packed, fast-paced, comic book-inspired stories!

items.title: Sweet Deceit
items.synopsis: Escalating in difficulty round by round, the teams work together to determine what is cake and prove it with their teeth by biting into their best guess, all in pursuit of a total prize up to $12,000.

items.title: Between Steps
items.synopsis: A former swimmer who rebuilds his life through robotics after losing his leg and a woman who finds a new academic path after drifting from her original dreams fall into a quiet, healing romance while studying mechanical engineering.

items.title: NCIS: New York
items.synopsis: Special Agent Sam Hanna returns to his hometown of New York City to the NCIS field office and partners with a roguish agent, Nick Schaeffer, to help lead a new team as they are tasked with high-stakes missions to defend one of the most vital cities and ports in the world.

items.title: kiDnap GAME
items.synopsis: Across seven Asian cities, strangers are forced into a deadly game where only one can save their loved one by beating the others.

items.title: Other Mommy
items.synopsis: A young girl, Bela, forms a relationship with a sinister entity in her home who looks uncannily like her own mother.

items.title: The Social Reckoning
items.synopsis: Frances Haugen, a young Facebook engineer, enlists the help of Jeff Horwitz, a Wall Street Journal reporter, to go on a dangerous journey that ends up blowing the whistle on the social network's most guarded secrets.

items.title: Carrie
items.synopsis: Misfit teenager Carrie White has spent her life in seclusion with her domineering mother, Margaret. After her father's sudden death, Carrie finds herself contending with the challenges of attending public high school, a bullying scandal, and the emergence of mysterious telekinetic powers.

items.title: Annie
items.synopsis: ‘ANNiE’, a Bangladeshi mini-series created, written, and directed by Abdullah Mohammad Saad, starring Nazifa Tushi.

items.title: Merry Berry Love
items.synopsis: When star Korean spatial designer Lee Yubin loses everything, he heads off to a Japanese island. There, he meets Karin, a resilient strawberry farmer. Hailing from different worlds, their lives collide in a big misunderstanding. Buckle up for "Merry Berry Love," a sweet and sour Korea-Japan rom-com.

items.title: Inside The Circle
items.synopsis: Four lifelong friends are caught in a web of blackmail when a leaked video threatens to expose the secrets that could destroy their friendship.

items.title: Matchbox the Movie
items.synopsis: When a group of former childhood friends reconnect, their reunion takes a wild turn as they stumble upon a dangerous international plot—and must save the world.

items.title: Cupertino
items.synopsis: A scrappy lawyer takes on a powerful tech giant in a high-stakes legal battle, navigating the cutthroat world of Silicon Valley while fighting for justice and the little guy's rights.

items.title: Eternally Yours
items.synopsis: Charles and Liz are a charming, married 500-year-old vampire couple whose relationship has survived centuries because, as vampires, divorce isn’t exactly an option. Together, they navigate modern society and their daughter dating a human.

items.title: Paige Prater
items.synopsis: Paige Prater loves making a difference. She uses her love spreading to show to make a difference.

items.title: GOR
items.synopsis: WHAT IF YOU GET TO ESCAPE  2 individuals from different state are stuck in a reality they can't escape while they encounter their own something vicious

items.title: Happily Married
items.synopsis: The story explores two people from different worlds and reflects on their perspectives on identity, family, society and relationships

items.title: Below
items.synopsis: When a mysterious sea creature terrorizes a small Newfoundland town, a hard-bitten fisherman and his family fight to protect their close-knit community.

items.title: Tenzing
items.synopsis: A determined man embarks on a high-stakes quest—and defies seemingly impossible odds—to fulfill his dream of being the first to reach the summit of Mount Everest.

items.title: Animals
items.synopsis: When the son of an L.A. mayoral candidate is kidnapped, he and his wife have a few hours to come up with the ransom payment. With most of their money spent on his political campaign, they have to get their hands dirty and expose a side of their lives they never intended to see the light of day.

items.title: Double Trouble
items.synopsis: Two witty sisters in Vegas get tangled in a holiday heist and join forces with an ex-MI6 guard to outmaneuver a master thief and recover a diamond gauntlet before Christmas.

items.title: Avatar: Seven Havens
items.synopsis: In a world shattered by a devastating cataclysm, a young Earthbender discovers she's the new Avatar after Korra. But in this dangerous era, that title marks her as humanity's destroyer, not its savior. Hunted by both human and spirit enemies, she and her long-lost twin must uncover their mysterious origins and save the Seven Havens before civilization's last strongholds collapse.

items.title: Mystery Science Theater 3000: The RiffTrax Experiments
items.original_title: Mystery Science Theater 3000: The RiffTrax Experiments
items.synopsis: Mystery Science Theater 3000: The RiffTrax Experiments is a 2026 limited series that reunites legacy MST3K writers and performers Michael J. Nelson, Kevin Murphy, and Bill Corbett. Serving as an official collaboration between the RiffTrax team and the MST3K production house, the series brings the core cast of the show's 1990s era back to the Satellite of Love.

items.title: Udta Teer
items.synopsis: An amnesiac Pakistani spy wakes up believing he is a patriotic Indian counter-terrorism officer.

items.title: Bokshi
items.synopsis: Anahita, traumatised by the brutal disappearance of her mother, finds comfort in Shalini, her history teacher. On an unconventional school excursion to a mysterious prehistoric site, she confronts her terrifying destiny.

items.title: Ben-Hur: A Série
items.synopsis: Judah Ben-Hur’s destiny is shaped by a complex friendship with the Roman Messala. Years later, a reunion with his childhood friend deals a blow capable of destroying him and tearing him away from the man he once was. Hollow inside, he is driven by only one thing: an unrelenting quest for justice. Or is it revenge?

items.title: Doctor X: Mafia in White
items.synopsis: Genius surgeon Gye Su-jeong joins Guseo University Hospital and quickly proves her brilliance while challenging flaws in the medical system, all while navigating complex relationships with the hospital’s director and an intern.

items.title: Take Charge of My Heart
items.synopsis: A corporate heir with an artificial heart meets a woman who's literally electric. They strike a deal that makes his heart beat — in more ways than one.

items.title: Mírame así, el camino de Noa
items.original_title: Mírame así, el camino de Noa
items.synopsis: Noa visits her boyfriend in Argentina, where she meets Tomy. As she explores her musical identity under parental pressure, Tomy tries to leave his musical past behind while both navigate life in Buenos Aires.

items.title: Firefly Wedding
items.synopsis: On the surface, Satoko has it all—she's beautiful, the daughter of a nobleman, and at a prime age for marriage. Unfortunately, she is also quite ill and only has a short time left to live. Before she can secure a marriage that will redeem her worth in her family's eyes, she finds herself the target of the mysterious assassin Shinpei, and her plans are put in jeopardy. In order to save herself, she makes a desperate proposal—of marriage! When it comes to love, however, Shinpei takes “until death do we part” seriously.

items.title: Cement
items.synopsis: A nightclub owner struggles to balance her work life with her romantic life over the course of one chaotic evening, and is ultimately forced to choose between past and present love.

items.title: The X Protocol
items.synopsis: Set in 1990, two bright ninth-grade students, Louiser and White, begin to uncover a terrifying secret hidden within their school. As strange and supernatural events surrounding their principal, Dravin, grow increasingly disturbing, the friends find themselves trapped in a haunting mystery that threatens their lives and everyone around them. A chilling prequel to the horror story Terror of X.

items.title: Rangbazz: The story of Deva
items.synopsis: Rangbazz is a gripping cinematic journey that explores the themes of power, struggle, and redemption. Directed by Divyank Pandey and produced under the banner of Action Film Industry, the story delves into the life of Deva, a man caught between his principles and the harsh realities of the world. With high-octane action and deep emotional undertones, the film showcases a new era of storytelling from the heart of Bilaspur.

items.title: 100 Days of Deception
items.synopsis:
100 Days of Deception (100일의 거짓말) is an upcoming 2026 South Korean period espionage television series directed by Yoo In-shik and written by Ryu Bo-ri. Scheduled to premiere on tvN on October 10, 2026, and broadcast internationally via Netflix, the drama is set in 1932 Gyeongseong under Japanese colonial rule.

The narrative follows a skilled pickpocket who assumes a fake identity to infiltrate the Japanese Government-General of Joseon as an undercover spy for the independence movement. Over the course of a 100-day mission, her operation collides with an elite interpreter who is the son of the Inspector General. The ensemble cast features Kim You-jung and Park Jin-young.

items.title: Treasure Island
items.synopsis: When Jim Hawkins gets his hands on a legendary treasure map, his mother Bess's clever and decisive actions leave him holding valuable knowledge that puts both of their lives in danger. Sailing aboard The Hispaniola, Jim and Bess are caught between the charming, terrifying pirate Long John Silver, and the debonair, duplicitous British agent Aaron Graham. Jim has to grow up fast as he and his mother fight for survival on a voyage where alliances shift, secrets multiply and peril closes in from all sides.

items.title: Dragon Ball Super: Beerus
items.original_title: ドラゴンボール超 ビルス
items.synopsis:
Several years have passed since the fierce battle against Majin Buu, and Earth has finally regained a brief moment of peace. At the same time, Beerus, the God of Destruction, awakens from his long, deep sleep. Even King Kai and Supreme Kai, aware of Beerus's overwhelming power to destroy entire planets, watch his awakening with great fear… Meanwhile, Beerus hears rumors of a Saiyan who defeated Frieza and suddenly appears before Goku. Targeted by Beerus, the strongest being in the universe, Earth is in grave danger. Thus begins an earth-shattering cosmic battle between the God of Destruction and Goku and his allies a conflict that will shake the entire universe.

Remastered and re-edited version of Dragon Ball Super.

items.title: Awake
items.synopsis: Based on his writings from a sleepless night in U.S. immigration detention, Mahmoud Khalil reflects on being separated from his family and the fragile promises of democracy, justice, and human dignity.

items.title: Street Fighter
items.synopsis: In 1993, estranged Street Fighters Ryu and Ken Masters are thrown back into combat when the mysterious Chun-Li recruits them for the next World Warrior Tournament: a brutal clash of fists, fate, and fury. But behind this battle royale lies a deadly conspiracy that forces them to face off against each other and the demons of their past. And if they don't, it's GAME OVER!

items.title: TYSON
items.synopsis: Explore the explosive life of Mike Tyson — one of the most feared and fascinating figures in sports history.

items.title: The Trap
items.synopsis: Follow famous author Lisa Konrad, who has not left her house for a decade after witnessing the murder of her sister. One night she sees who she believes was the murdered on television, and decides to use herself as bait to catch them.

items.title: Whalefall
items.synopsis: Following the death of his father, Jay Gardiner goes diving off the central Coast of California in search of his remains, but is swallowed by a massive sperm whale. While trapped inside its belly with only one hour of oxygen left, Jay comes to realize that the hard-earned lessons his father imparted may be the key to his escape.

items.title: VisionQuest
items.synopsis: With a bounty on his head, Vision must confront his nature and resist Ultron's influence to survive.

items.title: Hunting Gary Glitter
items.synopsis: Survivors, journalists and legal experts recount how pop star Gary Glitter used his money, fame and influence to carry out decades of child sexual abuse.

items.title: NOVA: Evolution
items.synopsis: “Nova: Evolution” is a five-part series from the GBH documentary unit together with the BBC and BBC Studios, which will trace the development of life from a single ancient cell into the many species alive today.

items.title: Afreet - A Never Ending Night
items.synopsis: Three friends gather for what should have been an ordinary evening, but a seemingly harmless challenge unleashes something far older and more dangerous than they could have imagined. As strange events begin to blur the line between reality and the unknown, they find themselves trapped in a night where every choice carries a consequence.  Afreet is a supernatural horror film that explores friendship, fear, and the hidden forces that emerge when curiosity goes too far.

items.title: Minotaur
items.synopsis: When Gleb, a successful company director, finds himself under siege from mounting corporate pressures, an increasingly unstable world, and the discovery of his wife's affair, the collapse of his carefully ordered life accelerates toward violence.

items.title: DARK MACHINE THE ANIMATION
items.synopsis: Popular esport DARK MACHINE captivates people all over the world and has transformed the economy of Japan, where there is an exclusive economic zone called "Golden Valley." Ajima is the seventh "Senki" — a title given to the game's strongest player — and effectively controls the region through DARK MACHINE. Protagonist Kairi arrives in Golden Valley with his late grandfather's final words in mind: "Find Senki." He then happens upon a young girl named Rudora, who is being pursued by Ajima's subordinate. Kairi becomes a DARK MACHINE player after connecting with Rudora, and his talent blooms with each fierce battle. Will Kairi be able to hold his own against Senki and carve out his own destiny?

items.title: Crystal Lake
items.synopsis: Single mother Pam Voorhees has been unable to shake her grief after her young, sickly son Jason tragically drowned in the town lake almost a year before. When two strangers arrive at Pam's door digging into her past, a disturbing chain of events is set into motion, leaving the townspeople of Crystal Lake wondering: just who is Pam Voorhees?

items.title: Hollywood Arts
items.synopsis: Struggling actress Trina Vega returns to her former high school, Hollywood Arts, as an unqualified substitute teacher, quickly finding herself both clashing with and unexpectedly inspiring a new generation of ambitious and talented students as they learn to find their true path at Hollywood's most elite performing arts school.

items.title: The Pellikandy Show
items.synopsis: Self proclaimed "Life Expert" Pellikandy hosts an educational show with his bumbling intern, Marko, covering everything from martial arts to alternative medicine, while selling out to absurd sponsors, getting sued, and giving away awful free prizes.

items.title: Jailer 2
items.synopsis: Following the events of "Jailer",  former ruthless police officer Muthuvel Pandian must come face-to-face with an even larger threat.

items.title: You Can See Everything
items.synopsis: Thirty-four days before she's sent to prison, notorious Silicon Valley founder Elizabeth Holmes invites a skeptical film crew to document her every move. What begins as an intimate portrait of an enigmatic felon becomes a mind-bending three-year journey into the abyss.

items.title: Cabaret Boys
items.synopsis: A fringe therapist takes the world by storm with a galaxy-brained new approach to self-help called the Jackman Method. Through immersive sessions, he transforms wayward young men into semi-employable outsider artists—all from the comfort of his posh home office in New York City. When an unhinged ex-patient returns to his care and is chosen to headline the practice’s first ever cabaret night, the fallout is immense. Diva behavior, grueling rehearsals, and public scandal threaten to destroy not only the show but the Jackman Method itself.

items.title: Masterplan
items.synopsis: When a legendary thief sets his sights on the Mona Lisa, he recruits two young strangers to help him before revealing they are long-lost siblings… and oh yes, by the way, he is their father. Thrown into a chaotic reunion they never asked for, this new family must learn to work together — and try not to kill each other — if they want any chance at pulling off the heist of the century.

items.title: Nayyi Navelli
items.synopsis: A new bride's arrival turns a turbulent household in Meerut into a picture of domestic harmony, until her brother-in-law grows convinced that his seemingly perfect sister-in-law is secretly a witch.

items.title: Prahaar
items.synopsis: Ujjwal Nikam is an Indian special public prosecutor who has worked on prominent murder and terrorism cases such as the 1993 Bombay bombings, the Gulshan Kumar murder case, the Pramod Mahajan murder case, and the 2008 Mumbai attacks.

items.title: Locker Diaries: Coven Academy
items.synopsis: The latest in Disney Channel's vertical short-form series.

items.title: Dreamland
items.synopsis:
Ever since his moth­er died in a fire, Ter­rence has seclud­ed him­self in an emo­tion­less world.

He goes through his dai­ly teenag­er life apa­thet­i­cal­ly… with one excep­tion! The sim­ple sight of a flame plunges him into a world of fear, an awak­en ver­sion of his night­mares – for, every time he falls asleep, he help­less­ly relieves the trag­ic event, thus rekin­dling his pyro­pho­bia. Until that one night he can’t bear it any­more and stops run­ning away from the dev­il­ish flames. Lit­tle does he know that, by doing so, he over­came his great­est fear and became a Trav­el­er: a very spe­cial kind of Dream­er, able to explore Dream­land, the dimen­sion born from mankind’s dreams… and nightmares!

items.title: Love in Disguise
items.synopsis: A gender-bending office rom-com where an undercover ex-soldier poses as a male bodyguard to investigate a wealthy, eccentric murder suspect.

items.title: The Golden Life
items.synopsis: Bound by decades of shared history, fallouts and friendship, this fan-favorite group of New Yorkers are starting fresh together in the Sunshine State. In this new ‘golden’ era of life, the longtime friends are thriving in and around Palm Beach with fabulous second homes and a bustling social scene. With their signature humor and non-stop hijinks, the group navigates dating, family, and career milestones. Though skies are bright in Florida, unresolved drama looms as they reconnect after years of highs and lows.

items.title: SOR
items.synopsis: In the series *SOR*, every patient represents a unique story, and successive shifts demonstrate that no two cases in the ER are alike. Patients admitted to the hospital will include, for instance, a critically injured motorcyclist whose condition fails to improve despite standard procedures; doctors and paramedics will also fight to save the life of a well-known TV presenter, while teenagers involved in a serious electric scooter accident will also arrive at the unit. A major test for the entire team will be a bus crash that places the ER on high alert. A large number of critically injured patients will arrive simultaneously, forcing doctors to make split-second decisions on which lives depend.

items.title: Cyberpunk: Edgerunners 2
items.synopsis: Weak, a washed-up cyberpunk legend, is now forced to live without chrome as he searches for a sense of purpose in a world that’s passed him by. Meanwhile, the deadly nomad D sets out on a path to revenge that brings him close to corpo secrets never meant to be found.

items.title: Clayface
items.synopsis: Matt Hagen's meteoric rise from Gotham street kid to Hollywood leading man is tragically cut short when a local crime boss's actions leave him horribly disfigured. Abandoned by his team and with nothing left, Matt seeks out a cutting edge treatment that miraculously returns him to his former self… but also unexpectedly affects his grip on reality, spiraling him down a destructive path of all-consuming revenge.

items.title: Wildwood
items.synopsis: Prue and her classmate Curtis are drawn into a magical forest filled with enchanted creatures, loyal allies, and formidable adversaries as they embark on a desperate quest to rescue Prue’s abducted baby brother from a murder of crows led by a mysterious woman named Alexandra.

items.title: Wicker
items.synopsis: On the outskirts of a village by the sea, lives a Fisherwoman; smelly, single and perpetually ridiculed. One day, fed up with her stuffy, small-minded neighbours, she commissions herself a husband to be made from wicker. In an otherwise conservative town, this unconventional romance sparks outrage, jealousy and chaos.

items.title: The New Stanford Prison Experiment
items.synopsis: In this modern reimagining of the infamous study, 30 people enter a real prison for two weeks and shifting power dynamics expose what they're capable of.

items.title: Klara and the Sun
items.synopsis: When Klara, an Artificial Friend who wants nothing more than to find the perfect home, meets Josie, each immediately senses a kindred spirit in the other. Josie has a fraught relationship with her mother and they've suffered great loss, but Klara's innocent wonder and unwavering loyalty begin to heal the family and bring light to Josie's complicated world.

items.title: Relict
items.synopsis: As his crew's loyalty crumbles and darkness closes in, an obsessed anthropologist pushes to capture the photograph he's spent his life chasing — before an ancient force claims what's left of his mind.

items.title: Couldn't Agree Less with Allison & Isaac
items.original_title: Couldn't Agree Less with Allison & Isaac
items.synopsis: Real-life couple Allison Kuch and Isaac Rochell invite viewers into their messiest, most honest disagreements — tackling everything from money and parenting to jealousy and in-laws through audience submissions, guest perspectives, and pop culture debates.

items.title: A Talent for Murder
items.synopsis: A young man travels from New York to Switzerland to try to persuade acclaimed thriller writer Patricia Highsmith to write one final installment of her Tom Ripley series, with his efforts gradually turning more sinister.

items.title: The Only Living Pickpocket in New York
items.original_title: The Only Living Pickpocket in New York
items.synopsis: Harry Lehman is an aging pickpocket who plies his trade with ever-diminishing returns in a drastically changed New York. Wallets stuffed with cash have been replaced by easily cancelled credit cards, and Harry struggles to make ends meet as he cares for his disabled wife, Rosie. When he unwittingly purloins and fences a valuable USB stick, Harry finds himself in a race against time to return the loot or face the rage of a vengeful crime family.

items.title: Newlyweds
items.synopsis: A mature romance about a free-spirited woman and a reserved professor who marry quickly after a brief, passionate courtship.

items.title: Pehla Pyaar Doosri Baar
items.synopsis: Three friends attend their school reunion and enter into different relationships, discovering the trials, tribulations, allure, and absurdities of love.

items.title: Little Thomas
items.synopsis: In early 1990s Goa, seven year old Thomas and his family navigate thr ups and downs in their lives.

items.title: Andhar
items.synopsis: In an isolated house where flowers wilt at a touch and time refuses to move in a straight line, a fragile young widow begins a new life, with a much older husband, she can't quite trust - haunted by warnings, watched by something patient, and carrying a secret that isn't only her own. When an impossible death draws a sharp-witted detective into the house's orbit, he finds a place that bends memory, guards an ancient purpose, and refuses to let anyone leave unchanged. What waits beneath is older than the walls, and the answer, when it comes at dawn, will reach further than anyone expects.

items.title: YAGA
items.synopsis: While a private investigator probes the disappearance of the young heir to a powerful fishery, he finds himself at odds with an apprehensive local detective, a charismatic university professor with a taste for younger men, and a labyrinth of enigmatic suspects, secret lives, and ancient magic.

items.title: Wake Up
items.synopsis: "Wake Up" tells the story of Emilia, whose world came to a standstill two years ago when her sister Clara fell into a coma following a severe skiing accident. When Emilia participates in a study on anxiety therapy conducted by nanobot researcher Hevi Abdel, something unforeseen happens: Hevi’s consciousness briefly migrates into Emilia’s body. For Emilia, this research becomes her last hope of bringing her sister back to life.

items.title: The Mob
items.synopsis: Celebrities compete in mob-themed challenges at an Italian villa for $250,000. They elect a don who controls eliminations and prize money. As power demands loyalty, contestants must decide whether to support the don or overthrow them.

items.title: Minimum Wage
items.synopsis: An overwhelmed group of teenagers struggle to run a local pizzeria while juggling school, a manic boss, and their minimum wage salaries. The stakes are low and the pressure is immense.

items.title: The One About Matthew Perry
items.synopsis: Told through intimate testimonies from close family and friends, this documentary event reveals the real Matthew Perry—generous, funny, vulnerable, larger than life—and the battles he fought to become the man behind the icon. A raw record of a life lived in full, and the honesty that became his greatest legacy.

items.title: Breeder
items.synopsis: An eccentric poodle breeder lures a broke college student to her remote ranch with a promise of research funding. But, as he soon learns, there’s a catch.

items.title: The Mongoose
items.synopsis: A falsely accused war hero with nothing to lose leads police on an epic televised cross-country car chase, helped by members of his former Special Forces Army battalion and closely monitored by a fascinated public rooting for his safe getaway.

items.title: Nocturne
items.synopsis: When a victim of notorious serial killer Jurek Walter unexpectedly turns up alive, detective Jonah Lynn races against time to find the one person still missing, while his protégé Saga Bauer goes undercover to get answers from the killer himself.

items.title: Balaraw: Blood Island
items.synopsis: Years after her mother vanished, Sabina follows a mysterious clue to an uncharted island, where she confronts hidden dark secrets within her own family.

items.title: Marina i Futa
items.synopsis:
"Marina and Futa" follows the rise of two young artists seeking their place in the music scene of the era, charting their journey to becoming one of the most renowned songwriting duos in the former Yugoslavia.

While crafting hits for the biggest stars of the time, Marina and Futa navigate personal challenges, crucial life decisions, and changes that shape their family. Their relationship, life together, and creative work are portrayed through a story of inspiring love, a family that provides strength, and music that lives on across generations.

items.title: Learning with Pibby: Armageddon
items.synopsis: A preschool cartoon character is stranded in corrupted worlds, deciding to save the universe as a hero or risk the Darkness consuming them first.

items.title: The Perfect Lie
items.synopsis: The story of two men and women who, the day after their perfect first date, are swept away in an unexpected direction in a storm of truth and lies.

items.title: Desperately Devoted
items.synopsis: Teri Hatcher reunites with her former on-screen daughter Andrea Bowen and her real-life daughter Emerson Tenney to revisit Desperate Housewives, reflecting on its most memorable storylines, characters and behind-the-scenes moments.

items.title: Bass X Machina
items.synopsis: In a lawless Steampunk West overrun by brutal outlaws, machines, and supernatural terrors, a father is forced to become judge, jury, and executioner—knowing that every act of justice meant to protect his family may ultimately cost him the very people he's fighting to save.

items.title: Godzilla Minus Zero
items.synopsis: War reduced Japan to zero, and Godzilla plunged it into minus. Two years have passed since then, and the country has faced agonizing struggles to achieve recovery and finally reclaim its daily life. Just as humanity managed to cling to a hard-won peace, a new threat strikes, crushing hope in an instant.

items.title: Ghost Soldier
items.synopsis: Henry “Fitz” Fitzgerald has spent years living quietly off the grid, hiding from a past few people know anything about. But when a powerful foreign corporation moves into his hometown to seize his neighbors’ land for a massive payday, Fitz is forced to reveal who he really is: a former Special Forces soldier and advanced weapons developer. Armed with experimental technology, lethal combat skills, and an unwavering code of justice, Fitz wages a one-man war against an enemy that never saw him coming.

items.title: Wild Horse Nine
items.synopsis: Shortly before the 1973 Chilean coup, CIA agents Chris and Lee are dispatched from Santiago to Easter Island by their bureau chief, MJ. Amongst the Island's iconic statues, and as the longtime partners wrestle with their dark pasts and present conspiracies, Chris's newfound bond with a pair of rebellious students threatens to send everyone’s trip to this remote paradise sideways.

items.title: The Cat in the Hat
items.synopsis: Assigned his toughest mission yet, the Cat must cheer up siblings Gabby and Sebastian as they adjust to life in a new town. Known for pushing boundaries, this agent of chaos must prove himself or risk losing his magical hat forever.

items.title: Club Kid
items.synopsis: A hard-partying New York City club promoter sees his whirlwind lifestyle upended by the arrival of the 10-year-old son he never knew he had.

items.title: The Greatest
items.synopsis: An intimate exploration of the incomparable life of Muhammad Ali. The amazing victories and defeats that made Ali a legend, both in and out of the ring, have been well documented and while those landmark events will live in The Greatest, the heartbeat of the story is fueled by all the moments that took place outside of the spotlight. The world remembers an icon, but The Greatest is about a man, a husband, a father, a brother, and a son.

items.title: The Remarried Empress
items.synopsis: Beloved Empress Navier rules the Eastern Empire alongside Emperor Sovieshu. But when Sovieshu falls for a runaway slave and demands a divorce, Navier will agree on one condition: that she's given approval to remarry rival Prince Heinrey of the Western Kingdom.

items.title: Ramayana
items.synopsis: An ancient epic follows a young prince and princess whose marriage and subsequent exile mark the beginning of a legendary journey. Their story of love, duty and destiny sets the stage for greater challenges ahead.

items.title: I Play Rocky
items.synopsis: The electrifying true story about an unknown actor with an unshakable belief that he wasn't just meant to write Rocky—he was meant to be Rocky Balboa. Told "no" at every turn, Sylvester Stallone bets everything on himself, holding the line on playing the lead against seemingly impossible odds.

items.title: Lakadbaggha 2: The Monkey Business
items.synopsis: Sequel to Lakadbaggha (2023). Plot TBA.

items.title: Ebenezer
items.synopsis: Tale of an elderly miser who embarks on a supernatural journey after visits from the ghost of his former business partner and the Spirits of Christmas Past, Present, and Yet to Come force him to confront his past and fight for a second chance at happiness.

items.title: How to Rob a Bank
items.synopsis: A crew of social media-savvy bank robbers broadcasts their daring heists, unaware that their growing viral fame has put them in the crosshairs of a veteran FBI agent and a brilliant software engineer. Despite the unlikely duo closing in, the crime ring pushes past their limits, putting everything on the line for their most ambitious heist yet.

items.title: Madden
items.synopsis: Chronicles John Madden's incredible journey alongside best friend and true original Al Davis—from a Super Bowl-winning partnership with the Raiders, to becoming football’s most recognizable voice, to building the worldwide Madden NFL video game.

items.title: The Body
items.synopsis: Sometimes, when you're a Catholic school dance troupe, your latest group initiation goes sideways. Maybe that means your choreographer dropped all the communion wafers on the floor, but for the girls of the coming-of-age drama "The Body", the results are a little more complicated. Their ritual-gone-wrong leads to a mass frenzy that engulfs an entire community.

items.title: Paper Tiger
items.synopsis: Two brothers become entangled in a scheme that turns out to be too good to be true. As they try to navigate their way through the dangerous world of the Russian mafia, family bonds begin to fray with life-altering consequences.

A heist takes 12 months to plan, 12 hours to execute—and a thief not caught within 12 days won't be caught at all. Across three pulse-pounding timelines, an FBI agent and a career criminal face off in a deadly game of cat and mouse through Europe.

items.title: The Good Daughter
items.synopsis: Sisters Charlotte and Samantha Quinn have spent the last twenty-eight years trying to piece together the lives that were fractured by a single night of violence. When another attack splinters the small town of Pikeville, Charlotte is the first witness on the scene. Now a lawyer like her father, she’s forced to confront her own demons as the case twists through one shocking revelation after another. In the end, both she and Samantha find themselves wondering if the price of being the good daughter was worth it after all.

items.title: Plucked
items.synopsis: In Gilded Age New York, a rebellious woman plans to divorce her emotionally unstable husband. Consequently, a polite and civilized evening violently spirals into pandemonium. Some things never change-until they do.

items.title: Montpellier
items.synopsis: In the year 1721, Sebastià Calaf, a mercenary grayed by war, tracketh a ravenous beast alongside his nephew Jaume, knowing not what foul horror awaiteth their steps.

items.title: The Hunger Games: Sunrise on the Reaping
items.original_title: The Hunger Games: Sunrise on the Reaping
items.synopsis: Return to the world of Panem 24 years before the events of The Hunger Games, starting on the morning of the reaping of the 50th Hunger Games, also known as the Second Quarter Quell.

items.title: V. Shantaram
items.synopsis: Chronicles Shantaram Rajaram Vankudre, aka V. Shantaram, on his remarkable journey from the silent era through the advent of sound and colour, showcasing his evolution as one of India’s most influential filmmakers.

items.title: The Altruists
items.synopsis: Follow the tumultuous romance between FTX co-founder Sam Bankman-Fried and his girlfriend Caroline Ellison and their ambitious attempts to revolutionize the financial system, leading to a $36 billion fraud.

items.title: Steps
items.synopsis: Think you know Cinderella's 'evil' stepsisters? Think again! When misunderstood Lilith is blamed for hijacking the Royal Ball with a stolen magic wand, she accidentally turns her sister Margot into a frog and leaves the kingdom in the hands of a prince-obsessed mean girl. Now Lilith must team up with Cinderella — and a surprisingly dreamy troll — to save the kingdom, repair the fractured fairytale, and prove that even so-called villains deserve a shot at happily-ever-after.

items.title: Elsinore
items.synopsis: The deeply emotional and inspirational true story of Ian Charleson, a gifted actor whose greatest challenge becomes his greatest triumph. Facing his own mortality with unflinching honesty, wit, and grace, Charleson delivers a courageous performance that becomes a source of healing and inspiration for those around him.

items.title: Dig
items.synopsis: Follow four women who work at an archeological dig in Greece. When the team uncovers a long-buried secret with the potential to rewrite history, they find themselves at the center of a high-stakes international conspiracy.

items.title: THE FURTHER MIS-ADVENTURES OF CLIFF BOOTH
items.original_title: THE FURTHER MIS-ADVENTURES OF CLIFF BOOTH
items.synopsis: Eight years after the events of Once Upon a Time in... Hollywood, Cliff Booth returns to a changing Los Angeles. Now working as a fixer in the shadows of the Hollywood studio system, Cliff finds himself entangled in a dangerous web of secrets, crimes and betrayals that will test everything he knows about loyalty and survival.

items.title: Hexed
items.synopsis: An impulsive and unconventional teenage girl named Billie discovers secret magical abilities which, once unleashed, hurtle her into a spectacle-filled journey out of suburbia and into a vast witch realm called Hexe. Forced to team up with her cautious mother, Alice, they uncover family mysteries that could change the world of witches forever.

items.title: Focker-in-Law
items.synopsis: Henry, son of Greg and Pam Focker, faces family chaos when he decides to marry a strong-willed woman who appears to be his complete mismatch.

items.title: Blade Runner 2099
items.synopsis: Fifty years after the events of Blade Runner 2049, Los Angeles has been reborn, just not by humanity. Cora, a fugitive in a final bid to stop running, takes on one last identity: a Blade Runner. Forced to partner with Olwen, a Replicant days from dying, she hunts down a runaway hiding a truth that could collapse their fragile city.

items.title: Fool Night
items.synopsis: In a dark world full of despair, he chooses the path of transforming into a Spirit Flower — a plant into which humans transform. Should he continue living as a person, or discard his pain and start a new life as a plant? Which path would you choose in his situation?

items.title: Yeh Prem Mol Liya
items.synopsis: A heartfelt romantic family drama about two best friends whose close bond slowly turns into love. But one lie creates misunderstandings and conflicts, putting their relationship and family bonds to the test. The story explores love, sacrifice, understanding and the importance of family.

items.title: Gunmaaster G9
items.synopsis: A man in love takes extreme measures to be with the woman he desires, facing off against a dangerous adversary.

items.title: Diler
items.synopsis: A Maddock Film

items.title: Ray Gunn
items.synopsis: In Metropia, a gigantic city in an alternate future as seen from 1939, private eye Raymond Gunn and his alien companion Eyera are making a living on the edge of society, delving into secrets that some people would rather keep hidden away. After accepting a sleazy spy job related to pop-star Venus Nova, Gunn finds himself drawn into a murder mystery unlike any case he’s taken.

items.title: Sri Sri
items.synopsis: He loved a girl with no past and gave her a future ....Now destiny returns to take her back , steeped in a forgotten life , buried memories and claims he cannot disprove, caught between destiny and love , she must decide what truly means

items.title: Pride and Prejudice
items.synopsis: Elizabeth Bennet is an unmarried woman and the second of five daughters of Mr. and Mrs. Bennet from Hertfordshire, near London. The Bennet home can only be inherited by males in the family, so the pressure is on for the daughters to marry well or risk losing everything. While out in society, Elizabeth interacts with single men like Mr. Darcy, an outwardly curmudgeon who is misunderstood.

items.title: Violent Night 2
items.synopsis: When Santa forgets the true meaning of Christmas, he finds himself in the heart of a lively mall community in desperate need of his help. Sapped of his magic, he’ll need another way to take on the goons threatening the mall, and time is running out. Santa has to rediscover his faith in goodness and call in some last-minute reinforcements from the one person no baddie wants to tangle with: Mrs. Claus.

items.title: Eetha
items.synopsis: Vithabai Narayangaonkar, a renowned Marathi Tamasha and Lavani performer rises from humble beginnings to become one of Maharashtra's most celebrated folk theatre artists.

items.title: Narayan Pustika 2 - Endless
items.synopsis: This movie is the second part of the Narayana Pustika trilogy. In which there is a description of the troubles arising from the opening of the unimaginable door revealed by the great sages.

items.title: The Debut
items.synopsis: When Mona Friedman is cast in a bit part at a small community theater, she transforms from a shy, unassuming housewife into a zealous method actor willing to do anything to protect the artistic integrity of her marginal role—even if it means waging war against the show’s domineering director.

items.title: The Murder of JonBenét Ramsey
items.synopsis: The series centers on one of the most infamous unsolved murder cases in American history, and the devastating personal and public reckoning that followed the death of JonBenet Ramsey on Christmas night in 1996.

items.title: Talk Money
items.synopsis: FINALLY, the raw, transparent conversations you wish you heard about money growing up. Find out what happens before the Grammys, Emmy, awards, elevation, recognition and success. Tune in to see how these exceptional guests transformed their passion into profit.

items.title: Zero A.D.: The Birth of Christ
items.original_title: Zero A.D.: The Birth of Christ
items.synopsis: A star rises over Bethlehem as Christ is born. But when Herod orders the slaughter of the innocents, Mary and Joseph must protect the child promised to save the world.

items.title: Visceral
items.synopsis: A group of friends goes through a crisis when one of them is accused of sexual abuse on social media.

items.title: Dune: Part Three
items.synopsis: Nearly two decades after he seized control of the Imperium, Paul Atreides is now a ruthless Emperor, and must face the consequences of his reign as old allies return, terrifying new threats emerge, and betrayal lurks in every shadow. Haunted by visions of Imperial collapse and the reappearance of his long-lost love, Paul is drawn into a sweeping conspiracy, with Chani at the heart of its unfolding mystery. As enemies close in, Paul must confront the true cost of power and the fate of those he loves the most.

items.title: Avengers: Doomsday
items.synopsis: Beloved heroes from three distinct universes are set on a deadly collision course and face an existential threat unlike anything they've ever encountered.

items.title: Unaccustomed Earth
items.synopsis: When a health crisis forces a devoted mother and her family to return to the US, she confronts buried desires that upend her Indian American community.

items.title: Quiztopia
items.synopsis: In an alternate Japan, a charismatic host runs a deadly quiz where winners get any wish and losers pay dearly. His world unravels when rebels target him.

items.title: The Eyes
items.synopsis: Flower Forever

items.title: The Angry Birds Movie 3
items.synopsis: Red faces his greatest challenge yet: surviving fatherhood… while saving the world.

items.title: Jumanji: Open World
items.synopsis: Our heroes have escaped the ever-changing jungles of Jumanji before, but this time the game comes to us - as Jumanji breaks free of its console, unleashing its chaos into our world.

items.title: Kumaari
items.synopsis: An upcoming thriller.

items.title: King
items.synopsis: Mentor and disciple embark on a perilous journey, pushing their survival skills to the limit against overwhelming odds and unforgiving environments.

items.title: The Alfred Eulogy
items.synopsis: Following the death of his friend Alfred, Ryan prepares to deliver a eulogy. What begins as an attempt to remember the dead gradually becomes a deeply personal confrontation with grief, guilt, resentment, loneliness, and everything left unsaid between two people.  As Ryan’s memories begin to fracture and contradict one another, the distinction between remembrance and reality slowly dissolves. The Alfred Eulogy is an intimate exploration of grief, masculinity, emotional repression, and the weight of words that were never spoken.

items.title: Mr. Irrelevant
items.synopsis: The last player selected in the 1983 NFL draft by the New York Giants, underdog John Tuggle defies expectations on and off the field for head coach Bill Parcells, his newfound love, and his team, proving that remarkable hope and perseverance can transcend even the greatest challenges.

items.title: Werwulf
items.synopsis: A harrowing tale of devotion, damnation and the devil within.

items.title: Harry Potter
items.synopsis: There is nothing special about Harry Potter - at least that's what his Aunt Petunia always says. On his 11th birthday, a letter of admittance to Hogwarts School of Witchcraft and Wizardry opens up a hidden world for Harry: one of fun, friendship and magic. But with this new adventure comes great risk as Harry is forced to face a dangerous enemy from his past.

items.title: Clara and the Below
items.synopsis: To save her bedridden ex-military father, Clara must fight the spirits of the soldiers he killed on the battlefield in a surreal world known simply as the Below. She is aided by a mischievous toy nutcracker, her only guide in a place where the ghosts of the past run rampant.

items.title: Student of the Year 3
items.synopsis: Student of the Year 3

items.title: Legends
items.synopsis: Follows the cast of "Sons of Anarchy" as they reunite at a fan convention after more than a decade, where the line between life and art blurs and the fractured brotherhood faces a real-world threat.

items.title: Mouthwashing : The Film
items.synopsis: The Indian Film Adaptation Of The Bone-Chilling Video Game - Mouthwashing

items.title: The Liberation
items.synopsis: Rita is entranced by the mesmeric Leader and renounces her family to embrace the world of the enigmatic Harmonia commune. Her daughters Ella and Jo put everything on the line to infiltrate the cult and bring their mother home. Yet, once immersed in the commune, they find themselves inexorably drawn into the Leader’s labyrinthine web of psycho-spiritual manipulation.

items.title: Golmaal 5
items.synopsis: Get ready for another rollercoaster of laughter with the iconic gang.

items.title: Children of Blood and Bone
items.synopsis: In the world of Orïsha, a young woman goes on a quest to reclaim the magic that was violently stolen from her people. She and her brother ally with the daughter and son of the king to fight back against his brutal rule.

items.title: Neuromancer
items.synopsis: A disgraced superhacker and a razorgirl assassin are recruited for a high-stakes heist targeting a powerful corporate dynasty with untold wealth...and secrets they'd kill to protect.

items.title: Love & War
items.synopsis: Two strong-willed Army officers find their lives intertwined with a woman, forming a complicated love triangle.
